card.vhead: Top 3 · for my setup and for a fresh setup

records.title: Eight ADEs tested: my top three

recommendationLabels.text: 01PASEOQualified. Best overall on the recorded tests, including a real OpenRouter request. The qualified terminal route uses a saved login-shell profile; the default remains non-login.

02SHEPRDProvisional. Terminal startup-file preservation is partly verified. Strong config-file support, open source and documented Linux builds put it ahead of Agentastic; chat needs an extra terminal-creation step.
03AGENTASTICProvisional. Configured input/keybinding behavior remains unverified. Good defaults and a tested free core workflow; closed source with no Linux desktop.
